environment: Node / happy-dom and fake-indexeddb; Range geometry and capture mocked; no real browser layout

tests.name: Legacy text pin uses selected glyphs, not the wide centered heading box
Document and nested-container scroll remeasure the text; offscreen pins disappear and return
Text pins follow width changes and wrapping even beyond the old 30px viewport guard
Selections crossing inline elements resolve to the first visible line fragment
New selection retains the chosen occurrence across save, import and subsequent DOM changes
Missing or ambiguous legacy text hides only the pin and keeps the note
Zero-size hidden text has no pin; left-edge text uses the right side
Element targets still use their box; malformed text anchors are discarded on import
